title: A coherent module mapping compatibly to an invertibly twisted inverse system
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], $F:\mathbb N^{\mathrm{op}}\to\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$ any inverse system, and $P$ an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module]. Specify a finite generating family $\sigma$ of compatible global sections of $F_0\otimes P$, indexed by a finite set $I$ [def-weil-pbc-generating-sections, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Suppose sections $s_{n,i}$ of $F_n\otimes P$ are given for every $n\in\mathbb N$, $i\in I$, with $s_{0,i}=\sigma_i$ and each adjacent transition carrying $s_{n+1,i}$ to $s_{n,i}$. Then there is a coherent module $G$ [pqf-def-coherent] and maps $g_n:G\to F_n$ commuting with adjacent transitions such that $g_0$ is epi. No annihilation or formal quotient hypothesis is imposed on $F$.

source.place: Proof of Lemma 0885 (lemma-existence-projective), first essential-surjectivity paragraph; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0885

proof.text: Take A to be the free module on the finite index set I. The cokernel presentation of the identity on A with zero relation module supplies a finite presentation. Let Q be the dual of P; nonempty_tensorObj_dual_iso_unit constructs the tensorRight(P) equivalence with inverse tensorRight(Q). Set G=A tensor Q. Twisting a finitely presented module by an invertible module is finitely presented (Scheme.Modules.isFinitePresentation_tensorObj); thus G is quasi-coherent and finite type. The locally Noetherian coherence criterion makes G coherent.

Define f_n:A to F_n tensor P using freeHomEquiv.symm on the given sections. The identity freeHomEquiv_symm_comp and adjacent compatibility of s give f_(n+1) followed by the twisted transition equals f_n.

Apply the inverse tensor equivalence to f_n and compose with the inverse unit isomorphism at F_n. These are maps g_n:G to F_n. Functoriality and naturality of the inverse unit prove adjacent compatibility. At n=0 the free map is sigma.pi, an epimorphism; the inverse equivalence and the unit isomorphism preserve this epimorphism.

proof_origin.place: Proof of Lemma 0885 (lemma-existence-projective), formalized by N2 using exact tensor equivalences and module-section maps

mathlib_searches.query: Compatible sections of an inverse system tensored with an invertible sheaf give compatible maps from a finite sum of its dual, with an epimorphism at the first level if the sections generate

lean.statement:
theorem coherent_cover_from_compatible_twisted_sections
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (F : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ X.Modules)
    (P : X.Modules) [P.IsInvertible]
    (σ : (Scheme.Modules.tensorObj (F.obj (op 0)) P).GeneratingSections)
    (hσ : σ.IsFiniteType)
    (s : ∀ n : ℕ, σ.I → (Scheme.Modules.tensorObj (F.obj (op n)) P).sections)
    (hzero : s 0 = σ.s)
    (hsucc : ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : σ.I), SheafOfModules.sectionsMap
      ((tensorRight P).map (F.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op)) (s (n + 1) i) = s n i) :
    ∃ G : CoherentModules X, ∃ g : ∀ n : ℕ, G.obj ⟶ F.obj (op n),
      (∀ n : ℕ, g (n + 1) ≫ F.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op = g n) ∧
        Epi (g 0)
